name: create-plan
title_zh: 动手前先把你追问到没话说的计划书生成器
tagline_zh: 你丢一句「做个迁移方案」，它先翻仓库、翻文档，再一轮轮追问到没有含糊处。
tagline_en: Give it one vague ask; it reads your repo and docs, then grills you round after round until nothing is ambiguous.
desc_en: Create detailed, comprehensive, execution-ready plans for engineering, architecture, research, reviews, migrations, investigations, operations, strategy, decisions, and other multi-step work. Use when the user asks to create, write, improve, pressure-test, decompose, or validate a plan before execution. Research available context first, run a mandatory adaptive grilling loop to resolve consequenti
why_zh: 先调研再追问再成文，追问是自适应的：你答得含糊它就继续挖，答清楚了才推进。
why_en: Research, then an adaptive grilling loop, then the plan. Vague answers get more questions; clear ones move it forward.
limit_zh: 它只产出计划文本，不写代码也不执行；追问轮次可能很长，想一句话拿结果的人会被问烦。上下文得让它读得到——仓库、文档。
limit_en: Produces plan text only — no code, no execution. The grilling loop can run long; if it can't read your repo or docs, it will just ask you instead.
title_en: A plan generator that grills you before you build
